name: Hiyoshi Kenji
source:
Likes: baseball, children
Dislikes: drinking alcohol, games

He works in the Manten East building as a part time worker. He's still well-muscled from his history of sports.
Kenji is a bit of a playboy, and came up to Mayu when she was alone in Manten Aquarium.

[Taken from [url=http://shizuku.aiueokompany.com/]Official Website[/url]]
